pages.title: Sniff
pages.text: Race 10: Chicago, 8.9 miles, with New York the longest race, twice as long as Denver. Password: PIZZA. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Bonus tracks
pages.text: Race well and a local skater invites you to a bonus track of their own: a Speed Course, a Trick Track, an Obstacle Course, a Chase Course, or King of the Bus: be the last one skitching.

pages.title: The field
pages.text: 26 rivals race for the cash, among them Fester, Jezebel, Karcass, Thrasher, Pickle, Splink, Pimple, Noxious and Dan Grr.
